name: security-plugin
description: Security audit tools for Claude Code: OWASP Top 10 checks for AI agent skills and for ordinary applications.

plugins.name: owasp-audit
plugins.description: Two OWASP security audit skills: owasp-agentic-audit (OWASP Agentic Skills Top 10, AST01–AST10) and owasp-app-audit (classic OWASP Top 10, A01–A10). Each writes a dated report with findings, severity, and suggested fixes.
